metadata.title: Mosaic Script on Rippled Water Collage

retrievalProfile.description: A tactile collage featuring a dimensional script word constructed from multi-colored mosaic tiles, set against a background of rectangular paper cutouts showing rippled swimming pool water.
excludeWhen: the text needs to be a standard font without texture

recipe.visualDefinition: A central, thick script word rendered as a 3D mosaic sculpture with irregular red, black, and gold tiles. The word floats atop a grid-like collage of square and rectangular photographic fragments depicting turquoise water with white caustic light patterns.
coreVisualRelationships: Textural contrast between jagged mosaic tiles and fluid water ripples
Dimensionality created by drop shadows beneath the script
Grid-based background construction using overlapping paper edges
Color harmony between cool turquoise water and warm red/gold tile accents
coreInvariants: Visible paper edges in the background grid
Irregular grout lines between mosaic tiles
Caustic light patterns on the water surface

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large, central script word occupying the middle horizontal third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Follows the cursive flow of the script from left to right, then outward to the tiled water background.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The surrounding water collage acts as textured negative space, maintaining a grid-like structure.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black and dark grey (mosaic grout and shadows)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Red, gold, and white (individual mosaic tiles and water caustics)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value in water highlights; high saturation in red tiles; low value in shadows for depth.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Cursive script with thick, uniform stroke weight
letterConstructionRules: Letters are formed by a dense arrangement of irregular polygonal tiles
Strokes have a rounded, tubular 3D appearance
Connections between letters are fluid and continuous
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase initial with large, sweeping loops
Lowercase letters with compact, rhythmic curves
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Standalone display type; no secondary typography.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the specific tactile nature of the tiled lettering.
Provides the base skeleton for the mosaic application.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a collage of rectangular paper cutouts, each showing a different section of turquoise swimming pool water with white caustic light patterns, arranged in a slightly irregular grid.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Render a thick, 3D script word in the center, filled with a mosaic of small red, black, and gold tiles, and add a soft drop shadow to make it appear as if it is floating above the water collage.

verificationChecks: Check for visible paper edges in the background
Ensure the script has a clear mosaic tile texture
Verify the presence of drop shadows for dimensionality
Confirm the water has realistic caustic light patterns

adjustableVariables: Water color (e.g., deep blue vs. turquoise)
postGenerationChecks: Does the background look like individual paper cutouts?
Is the script clearly made of mosaic tiles?
Is there a convincing shadow between the text and the background?
Are the water ripples varied across the collage pieces?
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Subject: Script Word] + [Texture: Mosaic Tiles] + [Background: Paper Collage Water Ripples] with [Effect: Drop Shadow Depth].
